summary: Signal Stage is a multiplayer 3D motion-graphics trip: P/ROLL starts or cuts a shared 198-second, 160-bpm track, with each viewer's camera and the scene shaders following its score. The main place now contains scripted field, eye and tunnel geometry/materials driven by a shared trip clock; the chamber scripts exist, but its placed object is still a blueprint box.
places: places/main/config.yaml (main place) - 3D, terrain off, black linear fog, default look and realistic sky; spawn (0, 0.1, 16), gravity -24Y.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - director plus trip-tagged field and eye assemblies at the origin and (0, 15, -34), with a stage floor.
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - five trip-tagged tunnel layers (wall, core, dust, gates, ribs) at (0, 9, -186), spanning the 300 m flight passage.
places/main/cells/x0z-3.scene - chamber blueprint box at (0, -9, -362), 50×48×50 m; it does not yet use the chamber scripts.
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry for player/camera templates, input actions, arrival, lighting, HUD and nametag.
templates/player.js#player - character root composing humanoid locomotion and player input/movement.
templates/camera.js#camera - custom first-person camera with the cinematic camera behavior.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#director - all-audience scripts/stage.js director for shared track and trip parameters.
scripts/ui.js - viewer-local ROLL/CUT and cinematic progress HUD.
shared: scripts/lib/cine.js - CPU score clock and camera interpolation shared by player, camera, director and HUD.
scripts/lib/data/score.yml and scripts/lib/data/shots.yml - track sections/layout and the shot keyframes read through cine.js.
scripts/lib/trip.js - shader clock, beat/audio envelopes and palette helpers used by field, eye and tunnel materials.

scripts/field-lib.js, scripts/eye-lib.js, scripts/tunnel-lib.js and scripts/chamber-lib.js - family-specific shared shader math; chamber helpers currently serve only the unplaced chamber script family.
notableExports: scripts/player.js exports onInput, update; scripts/camera.js exports finiteNumber, update.
scripts/stage.js exports update; scripts/lib/cine.js exports SCORE, SHOTS, CINE, cineTime, sectionAt, cameraAt, beatEnv.
scripts/lib/trip.js exports SCORE, SEC, BPS, tripClock, win, pal, stripes, HUE.
scripts/field-disc.js exports geometry; scripts/field-mandala.js exports material; field-orbs.js and field-stalks.js export geometry, with paired *-mat.js materials.
scripts/eye-iris-geo.js, eye-beads-geo.js, eye-lids-geo.js and eye-rays-geo.js export geometry; eye-iris.js, eye-beads.js, eye-lids.js, eye-pupil.js and eye-rays.js export material.
scripts/tunnel-geo.js exports geometry, collider; tunnel-wall.js, tunnel-core.js, tunnel-dust.js, tunnel-gates.js and tunnel-ribs.js export material.
scripts/chamber-*-geo.js export geometry and chamber-*-mat.js export material; scripts/chamber-fx.js and chamber-lib.js export shared helpers.
scripts/ui.js and ui/nametag.js export default; scripts/arrival.js exports onArrive, onLeave; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js exports sit, onInput, update.
ownership: scripts/player.js - owns local movement intent and writes shared world.state.cine = {start, by} or null on cine input.
scripts/stage.js on #director - owns director session and track/audio; propagates t0/on to trip-tagged object materials and place look/sky params.
scripts/camera.js / templates/camera.js - owns viewer-local rolling state and cinematic camera pose/FOV, returning to look orientation outside the roll.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - owns avatar gait/sit animation and locomotion scratch; scripts/player.js owns player input intent and velocity.
scripts/ui.js and ui/nametag.js - viewer-local presentation; neither owns shared cinematic state.
places/main/config.yaml owns place atmosphere, spawn, gravity and terrain mode; world.config.yaml owns world services, inputs and templates.
flows: world.config.yaml cine action (P) or HUD sendAction('cine') → scripts/player.js onInput → world.state.cine = {start: now + 300 ms, by} or null.
score.yml + shots.yml → scripts/lib/cine.js cineTime/cameraAt → each scripts/camera.js update follows the shared camera flight.
world.state.cine → scripts/ui.js render → idle ROLL or rolling progress/section label and CUT.
world.state.cine + score music → placed #director running scripts/stage.js → shared non-spatial track at timeAt=c.start; director clears audio when the roll ends or is cut.
scripts/stage.js → material.params.t0/on for objects tagged trip, plus look.params and sky.params; field, eye and tunnel scene objects consume these shader parameters.
scripts/lib/data/score.yml → scripts/lib/trip.js tripClock/palette → field-*, eye-* and tunnel-* scripted materials; their animation is shader-driven.
scripts/tunnel-geo.js geometry(kind) → five tunnel objects with different kind params; their separate tunnel-* material scripts render wall/core/dust/gates/ribs.
scripts/eye-iris-geo.js geometry → both eye iris and pupil discs with different radius/segment/z params; separate eye materials shade them.
world.config.yaml movement/jump actions → scripts/player.js onInput/update → character velocity; templates/player.js also runs humanoid locomotion.
templates/camera.js orientation.source=look → scripts/camera.js ordinary first-person pose; world.config.yaml arrival behavior → scripts/arrival.js.
world.config.yaml lighting/ui.render/nametag → scripts/lighting.js, scripts/ui.js and ui/nametag.js.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/field-* - one painted mandala disc, bead-stalks and orbs; field-lib.js shares field timing/placement math, with separate geometry and shader material scripts.
scripts/eye-* - iris, pupil, rays, lids and beads compose the portal; eye-iris-geo.js is reused for iris and pupil with different parameters, and eye-lib.js shares lid/eye timing math.
scripts/tunnel-* - five visual layers share tunnel-geo.js's kind-selected geometry and tunnel-lib.js's spatial/color helpers while varying material and geometry kind.
scripts/chamber-* - room, hex-frame, solid and FX geometry/material family shares chamber-lib.js and chamber-fx.js; currently not attached to the chamber place object.
templates/player.js composes humanoid-locomotion.js and player.js on each character: animation/gait versus movement input and velocity.
probableOrphans: scripts/chamber-*.js - chamber geometry/material family has no placed consumer yet; places/main/cells/x0z-3.scene still uses engine/blueprint.
scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js and scripts/lib/data/world.yml - terrain generator/data without a consumer while main terrain is off.
scripts/flower.js, scripts/grass.js, scripts/grass-look.js and scripts/pebble.js - meadow decoration code with no current place consumer.
migrationNotes: world.state.cine is the synchronized start/cut source; starts are scheduled 300 ms ahead. cine.js uses milliseconds for c.start/ctx.now() and seconds for score/shot keys.
stage.js converts c.start to shader t0 seconds modulo 3600 and writes params.on; it pushes to all objects tagged trip, and repeats the push for several ticks for late-built materials.
The shared score is 198 seconds at 160 bpm, first beat 0.35 s; shader tripClock uses the roll clock when on and otherwise free-runs the silent duration loop.
Coordinates are metres, +Y up: field centre (0,0,0), upright eye centre (0,15,-34), tunnel runs -Z from -36 to -336, chamber centre (0,15,-362).
The chamber scene remains a blueprint despite chamber scripts; design.md also mentions serpents and scripts/sky.js/look-trip.js, which are not present in the current tree.
